scenes.label: Meet Rohan
scenes.title: One last level!
scenes.caption: Meet Rohan. He's spent all week building a moon base in his favourite game. He's so excited to show his friends! His password? Rohan one two three. Easy to remember... but easy for someone else to guess, too.
scenes.dialogue: My friends are going to love this!

scenes.label: The surprise
scenes.title: Someone got into my account!
scenes.caption: The next day, Rohan can't sign in. Someone guessed his easy password and changed it. Now he can't reach his moon base. Rohan feels upset. If this happens to you, tell a trusted adult. You don't have to fix it alone.
scenes.dialogue: My moon base… I can’t get in.

scenes.label: Get help
scenes.title: Let’s get your account back.
scenes.caption: Rohan tells his mum. Together, they use the game's official account recovery steps. They get his account back, change the password, and sign out other sessions. Now, let's help Rohan make a password that's harder to guess.

scenes.label: Build a better key
scenes.title: Small words. A much longer secret.
scenes.caption: Try five unrelated words: Lantern. River. Cactus. Moon. Pebble. Together, they make a long practice passphrase. Avoid your name, birthday, or simple number patterns. This is only an example. Never use a password you've seen in a lesson.

scenes.label: Add protection
scenes.title: One account. Its own secret.
scenes.caption: Rohan's school account needs a different password. Reusing the same one could put both accounts at risk. His mum also helps turn on two-step verification, where available. That's an extra check when someone signs in.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Back to the moon!
scenes.caption: Rohan can play again, and he's smiling! His account is better protected, though no password makes an account completely safe. He knows to keep it private and ask for help. Your turn: help Rohan practise building a new secret!
